CHECKPOINT: GREEN phase complete. Modified plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-init.sh to:
1. Add .scratch/ to main repo .git/info/exclude (idempotent, grep-guarded)
2. Add .scratch/ to tickets-tracker worktree-specific .git/info/exclude via .git pointer file parsing (worktree-specific path, not the shared exclude returned by git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude)
3. Include .scratch/ in newly-committed tickets-branch .gitignore
4. Pre-upgrade path: appends .scratch/ to existing tickets-branch .gitignore if absent

Also updated .test-index: removed [test_scratch_gitignore_in_exclude] RED marker, added test-scratch-isolation.sh to the ticket-init.sh entry.

Results: test-scratch-gitignore.sh 9/9 PASS, test-scratch-isolation.sh 4/4 PASS, test-scratch-lib.sh 39/39 PASS (no regression).
